title: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: The Best Ways, Early to Late Game
desc: How to make money fast in GTA 6: stolen cars early, jewelry and high-end cars in Chapter 3, bank vaults late, plus the money cheat and how to keep your cash safe. Light on spoilers.
lede: Short answer: steal and sell cars early, move to jewelry jobs and high-end cars once they unlock, and save the bank vaults for late in the story: guides agree they pay the most. Keep your cash in the bank, not your pocket.
sections: Early game: steal and sell cars

The quickest early cash is stealing cars and delivering them to Moses; a run can take just a few minutes. Payouts in guides vary a lot by car and job, so check the offer in-game before you drive across the map.

In Chapter 3, a fence named Yasmani starts buying stolen jewelry, and guides report a jewelry store job pays far more than a corner-store robbery. Randy pays for high-end cars in good condition; you'll need the key cloner for those.
Late game: bank vaults pay the most
Guides agree the biggest payouts are the bank vault robberies, which open late in the story. Plan your gear and getaway first: the wanted system is stricter than in older GTAs.
Small store robberies pay little for the heat they bring. And money glitches: they get patched fast and can break saves, so we don't list them.
Money you carry can be lost if you're wasted or busted, so put it in the bank at an ATM or through the phone's banking app.
There's a cheat for money, but it unlocks after you finish the story, and cheats turn off saving and trophies for that session. The verified cheat list.
note: Methods and unlock points come from launch-week guides by GamesRadar, PowerPyx, GTABase and Dexerto; payouts differ between guides and can change with patches. Light on spoilers: only where each method unlocks. Checked November 24, 2026. Vice Replay is a fan site, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
faq: What's the fastest way to make money in GTA 6?
Early on, stealing and selling cars to Moses; later, jewelry jobs, high-end cars for Randy and, late in the story, bank vaults, which pay the most.
Is there a money cheat in GTA 6?
Yes, but it unlocks after the story and turns off saving and trophies for that session.
Is there a GTA 6 money glitch?
Glitches get patched quickly and can break saves, so we don't recommend them.
